Ekoji
Ekoji I alias Vyankāji, founder of the Tanjore Maratha dynasty, 1676-1683 A. D. [Page075-a.

Ekoji(ekarāja)
Ekoji II alias Bāvā Sāhib, king of Tanjore, son of Tulaja. A. D. 1735-6.
--Āryāśataka or Devīmāhatmyaśataka in Āryā metre. TD. 19477.
--Gaṇeśakavaca. TD. XX. Sup. no. 884 (f).
--Prapañcāmṛtasāra, otherwise called Rājarañjanapurāṇa. Mahādeva, court poet, wrote it for him; see Col. of TD. 7655. TD. 7655-60 (different sections, Parabrahmanirūpaṇa, Rāmānujamatakhaṇḍana, Madhvamatakathana). 18909-40 (different sections).
His minister, Nṛsiṁha II, son of Ānandarāya an. Jayantī, wrote the Tripuravijayacampū, TD. 4036. See also p. 28-9. V. Raghavan, Intro. to his edn., Śāhendravilāsa, Tanjore Sar. Mah. Ser. 54, 1952.
Jagannātha (Umānandanātha, NCC. II. p. 390a) wrote Ratimanmathanāṭaka (edn. Grantharatnamālā) in his court. See also D.. C. Kunhan Raja Presentation Volume, Adyar Library, 1946, p.. 280 ff.
